TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Tou kidi kanna ni-dyllough ta ti Jesus ki I-oep-an pou-qua tou pæulæpæulæh, alei ki r'pung-eih ki Lyttou [kmæu-eirau] tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then was Jesus led up of the spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
當時，耶穌被聖靈引到曠野，受魔鬼的試探。

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-rmierkud makk'ahpat kyttiæn ki wæ'i, makk'ahpat kyttiæn-appa ki euvan, si-æuh ki anna ni-mah-gangei-ra.
S.TRANSL: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
他禁食四十晝夜，後來就餓了。

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-iroua tyni-æn ta Tama-rpung [kmæu-eirau] ni-k'ma; Irou ka Alak-kow ki Alid, pa-sousou-ei, ka paha-papa'ul-auh ta vahto k'atta.
S.TRANSL: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
那試探人的進前來，對他說：「你若是上帝的兒子，可以吩咐這些石頭變成食物。」

S.FORM: Nda, teni ta mattæ'i-vli ni-k'ma, Ni soulat-ten-da, Assi dyk na pa'ul ta pa-kæuægh ki ka'æuloung, râ tou ymd-appa ki sou ka tæi-qua mou-pænæh tou moutous ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
耶穌卻回答說：「經上記着說： 人活着，不是單靠食物， 乃是靠上帝口裏所出的一切話。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-mara ta Lyttou pou-qua tyni-æn tou Euma ka papa anni-in pa-t'amud, ka ni-pa-itou-qua tyni-æn pa-itou-sapat tou pa-hgahakb-an ki apang ki Kouva ki tatamd-en ki Alid,
S.TRANSL: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
魔鬼就帶他進了聖城，叫他站在殿頂上，

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Heirou Alak-kow ki Alid, pou-aryng-â pou-rarim pou-mado ymhou-an, alei ka ni-soulat-ten-da, Ka mamoummou-ah ki Tama-gnau tyn alei ymhou-an, ka pa-itou halap-ah ki rima hmapoulou ymhou-an, ki assi ymhou d'æur-auh ta vahto ki rahpal oho.
S.TRANSL: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
對他說：「你若是上帝的兒子，可以跳下去，因為經上記着說： 主要為你吩咐他的使者 用手托着你， 免得你的腳碰在石頭上。」

S.FORM: Ka na-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Na æ'æ-lali-kough smoulat, Assi kow r'-pung-ah ki MEIRANG ka Alid oho.
S.TRANSL: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
耶穌對他說：「經上又記着說：『不可試探主－你的上帝。』」

S.FORM: Ni-hala mara ta Lyttou pouqua tyni-æn tou voukyng ka mara-mal, ka ni-madouk tyni-æn ymmid ki pei-sasou-an ki ymmud ki næi, ki keirang-en-appa ki kidi nein.
S.TRANSL: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
魔鬼又帶他上了一座最高的山，將世上的萬國與萬國的榮華都指給他看，

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Pi'æ'æym'd-ei-mau-kow pi'æ ki mamang k'atta, rou maæu-hakup kow makou-Alilid jau-an.
S.TRANSL: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
對他說：「你若俯伏拜我，我就把這一切都賜給你。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, D'marang-â Tama-Makou-doumma: ka ni-soulat-en-ra, MEIRANG ka Alid oho ta pakou-hakub-au-'mhou, ka dyk tyni-æn ta tatam'd-ei-'mhou-ra.
S.TRANSL: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
耶穌說：「撒但，退去吧！因為經上記着說： 當拜主－你的上帝， 單要事奉他。」

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-atta-ral tyni-æn ta Lyttou; Ka kytt'ey, ni-iroua ta Tama-Gnau milligh tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
於是，魔鬼離了耶穌，有天使來伺候他。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-millingigh ta ti Jesus, ka ni-pæ'æ-tounnoun [papou-sangat] ta ti Joannes, ni-salikough [mou-'nni] mou-qua tou Galilæa.
S.TRANSL: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
耶穌聽見約翰下了監，就退到加利利去；

S.FORM: Ka rou ni-d'arang-en tyn ta Nazareth, ni-irouä taulla tou Kapernaum, ka tou tamang ki vaoung, tou kidi ki pourou-pourough ki Zabulon-appa ki Neftalim appa.
S.TRANSL: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
後又離開拿撒勒，往迦百農去，就住在那裏。那地方靠海，在西布倫和拿弗他利的邊界上。

S.FORM: Alei ka pa-væut-auh ta na sou ki na Tama Mattæ'i-tan ka ti Esajas, ka koun,
S.TRANSL: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，

S.FORM: Pourough ki Zabulon, pourough-appa ki Neftalim tou darang ki vaoung, tou arough ki Jordaan, Galilæa ki ta'uta'u.
S.TRANSL: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
說： 西布倫地，拿弗他利地， 就是沿海的路，約旦河外， 外邦人的加利利地－

S.FORM: Ta'uta'u ka miroung tou karumdum-an ni-kmytta ki ræmæh ka irang: Neni ka ni-miroung tou pourough tou haloung-appa ki kapatei-an, ni-'ou-tiæg-han ki ræmæh neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
那坐在黑暗裏的百姓看見了大光； 坐在死蔭之地的人有光發現照着他們。

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna ni-matta-naunamou ta ti Jesus matta-sasou, mattæ'i-k'ma-hynna, Si-lala, pa-salikough-â ki vanna-oumi ki ryh, ka ni-mou-touk ta pei-sasou-an ki tounnoun ki vullu-vullum.
S.TRANSL: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
從那時候，耶穌就傳起道來，說：「天國近了，你們應當悔改！」

S.FORM: Ka tou hi-ryttoung-en mou-nounang ti Jesus tou Saidd ki vaoung ki Galilæa, ni-kytt-'an tyn ta rarouha ki mahta-tæ'i-appara, ta ti Simon ka Petrus ki siouwa, ti Andreas-appa ka tæ'i-appara tyn, ka smaki-vaoung ki rarei-houl (ka na-tama-'ou- d'llum ta neni.)
S.TRANSL: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
耶穌在加利利海邊行走，看見弟兄二人，就是那稱呼彼得的西門和他兄弟安得烈，在海裏撒網；他們本是打魚的。

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'm-'ato-hynna neini-æn, mæu-æuu-hâ jau-an, ka pa-sih-qua-au-mau-kamou pa-'ou-d'llum ki kaæuloung.
S.TRANSL: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
耶穌對他們說：「來跟從我，我要叫你們得人如得魚一樣。」

S.FORM: Ka dou madys atta-ral ki rarei-houl, ni-æu-æuug-han nein-tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
他們就立刻捨了網，跟從了他。

S.FORM: Heirou ka ni-mali-deua ta teni makka-qua-hynna, ni-k'ytt'an tyn ta rarouha ki mahta-tæ'i-appara ka pani, ta ti Jakobus [k'allak] ti Zebedæus, ti Joannes-appa ka tæ'i-appara tyn touh-para ti Ama nein ka ti Zebedæus tou avang si-äpapat ki k'akæuæur nein, ka ni-t'æt'æ-æm tyn ta teni.
S.TRANSL: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
從那裏往前走，又看見弟兄二人，就是西庇太的兒子雅各和他兄弟約翰，同他們的父親西庇太在船上補網，耶穌就招呼他們，

S.FORM: Ra neni k'anna dou ni-madys d'marang ki avang ka talou, ki Raram'an-appa nein, ni-mæu'æuugh tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
他們立刻捨了船，別了父親，跟從了耶穌。

S.FORM: Ka ni-hmæ-veiæh tau-ryttoung ta ti Jesus tou ymmud ki Galilæâ, mahtatæutæuugh tou Pæuisa-saäl-en nein, matta-sasou ki Hagnau ka Mariang ki Pei-sasou-an, pæh-darikagh ymmid ki maälam, ymd-appa ki mi-væuæ̈loung tou tautau-an.
S.TRANSL: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
耶穌走遍加利利，在各會堂裏教訓人，傳天國的福音，醫治百姓各樣的病症。

S.FORM: Ka ni-pa-'ou-louma-louma'n ta 'illing-hen ki nanang tyn tou ymmid ki Siria, ka ni-æd nein tyni-æn ymmid neini-æn ka assi mariang ki voäl ka mannini ki malam, ki pæ'i-alalam-en, ka 'isasaun-nen ki Lyttou, ka pis-bouravoural pis-koupang, ka dimmi-dimmi-en [ki voäl] ka ni-papædari-kagh tyn ta neni.
S.TRANSL: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
他的名聲就傳遍了敘利亞。那裏的人把一切害病的，就是害各樣疾病、各樣疼痛的和被鬼附的、癲癇的、癱瘓的，都帶了來，耶穌就治好了他們。

S.FORM: Ka mabatoung ta Makouilalaulau ka ni-mæu-æuuh tyni-æn, makka Galilæa, makka Dekapolis, makka Jerusalem, makka Judeä, makka-arough-appa ki Jordaan.
S.TRANSL: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
當下，有許多人從加利利、低加坡里、耶路撒冷、猶太、約旦河外來跟着他。
